actions.create_bill.description: Creates a bill (accounts payable) in QuickBooks.
actions.create_bill.props.dueDate.descri: The date the payment is due. If empty, the vendor/company term is used.
actions.create_bill.props.lineItems.desc: Details of the bill (expense categories). At least one line is required.
actions.create_bill.props.txnDate.descri: The date of the bill. Defaults to today if empty.
actions.create_expense.description: Creates an expense transaction (purchase) in QuickBooks.
The account from which the expense was paid.
actions.create_expense.props.entityRef.d: Optional - The vendor the expense was paid to.
actions.create_expense.props.lineItems.d: Details of the expense (e.g., categories or items purchased). At least one line is required.
actions.create_invoice.props.billEmail.d: Email address to send the invoice to. Required if Email Status is "Needs To Be Sent". Overrides customer default.
actions.create_invoice.props.customerMem: Memo to be displayed on the invoice sent to the customer (appears on statement).
actions.create_invoice.props.docNumber.d: Optional reference number for the invoice. If not provided, QuickBooks assigns the next sequential number.
actions.create_invoice.props.dueDate.des: The date when the payment for the invoice is due. If not provided, default term from customer or company is used.
actions.create_invoice.props.emailStatus: Specify whether the invoice should be emailed after creation.
actions.create_invoice.props.privateNote: Note to self. Does not appear on the invoice sent to the customer.
actions.create_invoice.props.txnDate.des: The date entered on the transaction. Defaults to the current date if not specified.
actions.create_vendor.props.acctNum.desc: Your own reference/account number for this vendor (external ID). Shown on checks.
actions.create_vendor.props.billAddrStat: State or province code, e.g. CA.
The name QuickBooks will show for this vendor. Must be unique across all vendors, customers, and employees.
actions.create_vendor.props.termRef.desc: Optional. The default payment term for bills from this vendor.
actions.create_vendor.props.vendor1099.d: Whether this vendor should be tracked for 1099 reporting.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.find_account.description: List or search the chart of accounts to get an account Id (e.g. an expense account for a bill).
actions.find_account.props.search_term.d: Optional. Filter accounts whose name contains this text.
actions.find_customer.description: Search for a customer by display name in QuickBooks.
The display name of the customer to search for.
actions.find_invoice.description: Search for an invoice by its number in QuickBooks.
actions.find_invoice.props.invoice_numbe: The document number (DocNumber) of the invoice to search for.
actions.find_payment.description: Finds an existing payment in QuickBooks.
actions.find_payment.props.customerId.de: The ID of the customer to find payments for.
actions.find_vendor.description: Search for a vendor in QuickBooks by display name, email address, or account number.
actions.find_vendor.props.search_term.de: The exact vendor display name, email address, or account number to search for, depending on Search By.
actions.read_aging_report.description: Reads an accounts receivable or accounts payable aging report from QuickBooks.
actions.read_aging_report.props.agingMet: Whether buckets are calculated from the report date or from each transaction's due date.
actions.read_aging_report.props.agingPer: Number of days in each aging bucket (e.g. 30).
actions.read_aging_report.props.numPerio: How many aging buckets to include.
Only include transactions overdue by at least this many days.
actions.read_aging_report.props.reportDa: The date to age balances against. Defaults to today if empty.
actions.record_bill_payment.description: Pays one or more vendor bills in QuickBooks, in full or in part, by check or credit card.
actions.record_bill_payment.props.billLi: One or more bills this payment applies to. Amounts can be less than the bill balance for a partial payment.
actions.record_bill_payment.props.payFro: The checking/savings account (for Check) or credit card account (for Credit Card) the payment is made from.
actions.record_payment.description: Records a customer payment in QuickBooks, optionally applying it to invoices.
actions.record_payment.props.depositToAc: Optional. The account to deposit the payment into. Defaults to Undeposited Funds if empty.
actions.record_payment.props.lineItems.d: Optional. Apply this payment to specific invoices. Leave empty to keep the amount unapplied.
actions.record_payment.props.paymentRefN: Optional reference number for the payment (e.g. check number).
actions.record_payment.props.totalAmount: The total amount of the payment received.
actions.record_payment.props.txnDate.des: The date the payment was received. Defaults to today if empty.

triggers.new_bill.description: Triggers when a new bill (accounts payable) is created in QuickBooks.
triggers.new_customer.description: Triggers when a new customer is created.
triggers.new_deposit.description: Triggers when a Deposit is created.
triggers.new_expense.description: Triggers when an Expense (Purchase) is created.
triggers.new_invoice.description: Triggers when an invoice is created .
triggers.new_or_updated_invoice.descript: Triggers when an invoice is created or updated in QuickBooks.
triggers.new_transfer.description: Triggers when a Transfer is created.
